meta.title: Poinsett County — the money trail
meta.note: This is Poinsett County's 2026 budget, adopted by Appropriation Ordinance 2025-26 and filed with the state as a scanned copy. We use the budget amounts in the county's January 2026 budget detail report; every fund matches the ordinance, and together they equal its $14,481,266.82 in total expenditures. The General Fund also moves $2,302,065.60 to other county funds; that money is spent and counted in the funds that receive it, so it is not added again here.
